text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grand banquet was arranged, inviting all 
the local hot spring district personnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Yukoma Ryokan would be hosting 
and overseeing the banquet this time. As a 
gesture of gratitude for their 
hospitality, I decided to help with 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: So, did you leave the flowers?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is the one, right...? Yeah. Thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Though, the way it's placed right now, 
guests might catch their sleeves on it.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, I'll take care of 
the rest. Oh, right, could you go check on 
Yunohana over there?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
My, is that a helping hand from the 
landlady? Ufufu, .
choice_data_list: So, is there anything I can help with……?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we arrange the cushions? 
The count and layout go like this~—

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! My apologies. I really should 
have told you beforehand...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
This is actually the front side of the 
cushion. The one you placed down, Trainer, 
was face-down...
choice_data_list: Ah, I'll fix that right away!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
No, no~. My hands are free now, so I'll 
handle the rest. Please rest until your 
scheduled time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Now I'm left with nothing to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, no matter what I try, I'm clumsy at 
it. In the end, they always have to fix it 
for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few hours later.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so very much for 
taking time out of your busy schedules to 
join us today.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Today, our Yukoma Inn is delighted to 
provide you all with a lovely time to 
deepen your bonds.

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The banquet got underway. I quietly 
slipped into a corner and listened to the 
landlady's opening address on stage.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
First, a toast. Allow me to lead the 
honors.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Historic Ryokan Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're with Yukoma Inn, right? 
Are you sure this seat is okay for you?
choice_data_list: I'd feel bad lining up over there...

text_block_list.name: Historic Ryokan Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Is that so? Well then, if you'll 
excuse me... Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, my.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, everyone, pardon the intrusion 
while you're conversing.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
In accordance with our customs, our inn, 
as the host, shall present a offering of 
song and dance for you.

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you! All hail the 
Hot Spring Goddess!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please, enjoy yourself to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as the young mistress takes her 
stance, a moody karaoke intro begins to 
play.

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a duet song! ...Wait, huh? The young 
proprietress started dancing without 
holding a microphone? Who is she planning 
to sing with...?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: (*glance glance*)

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: (*glance glance glance*)

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Locals
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! What in the world are you 
doing in a place like that?!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Really, now... Look, the intro is about to 
end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by the atmosphere, I hurried 
over to the landlady at a trot.
choice_data_list:
Um, are you really sure someone like me is 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Something"? ...Don't go acting like 
a stranger now, sheesh!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why you're being so modest. 
Is there anyone else we could possibly 
entrust this situation to?
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...*inhale*.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
♪ Hey, you're trying your hardest, aren't 
you? A cassette filled with all my 
feelings

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
♪ Rewind it, hit play Memories 
boogie-woogie

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by a wink, I hurriedly looked at 
the karaoke screen. Grasping the mic, I 
followed the scrolling lyrics.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
♪ Hey, you gave it your all, didn't you? I 
was watching over you the whole time I'm 
sure this voice will bring back those days

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking the lyrics out loud, I realized 
it. —This was a fight song.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She said she was watching me work hard all 
along. Embracing everythingâmy 
greenness, my inexperience, and my 
flawsâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had acknowledged me enough to let me 
stand right alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your kind attention.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please continue to favor our inn 
and――

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Please lend your warmest support to this 
young Trainer, whom you all already know 
so well.
